name: enforce-testing-coverage
description: Validates that code changes include corresponding tests and validates coverage requirements are met

rules.message: New code should have a corresponding test file (e.g., Feature.tsx -> Feature.test.tsx)
Test coverage must be at least 80% for all new files
Tests should use describe() blocks to group related tests
Use async/await syntax for asynchronous tests instead of done() callbacks

actions.message: Coverage below 80%! Generated code must include tests. Use /testing prompt to create them.
Code generation blocked: Test file required. Use /testing to create tests before committing.
